meta.title: ProcessIQ — Cross-Process Compound Patterns
meta.note: Collective intelligence layer. Each compound fires when specific per-process patterns co-occur for the same entity.

compounds.name: Bust-Out Fraud Setup
compounds.description: Customer simultaneously gaming dispute timing (Collections), requesting duplicate refunds (Cash App), and showing credit deterioration (Credit) — the classic bust-out precursor. No single process sees all three.
compounds.recommendation: Immediate credit hold + joint review by Collections, Credit, and Cash App teams. Do not process any refunds until the investigation completes.

compounds.name: Systematic Revenue Leakage
compounds.description: Dispute splitting, Friday-afternoon slicing, and month-end RMA dumps recurring for the same account — deductions engineered to slip through under review thresholds and close-day noise.
compounds.recommendation: Consolidate the account's deductions into a single dispute case, freeze auto-approval below threshold, and require substantiation before any credit memo posts.

compounds.name: Credit Deterioration Cascade
compounds.description: Bust-out precursor velocity, partial breadcrumb payments, and a bureau downgrade stacking up over a quarter — three independent credit-risk tells converging on the same customer.
compounds.recommendation: Re-underwrite the account: reduce the credit limit, move to prepay/COD on new orders, and route open AR to priority collections before exposure grows.

compounds.name: Stalling-to-Write-Off Pipeline
compounds.description: Missing-PO traps, approval musical chairs, a system-migration stall, and portal sabotage chained across half a year — an aging campaign engineered to run the invoice to write-off.
compounds.recommendation: Escalate to the account owner and legal watch-list; set a hard resolution SLA, disable further stalling loops, and stop the clock before the balance reaches write-off age.

compounds.name: Cash Application Warfare
compounds.description: Duplicate-payment bait, unapplied-cash weaponization, and remittance decoupling hitting the cash-application queue together — a deliberate assault on match rates and float.
compounds.recommendation: Quarantine the customer's incoming payments for manual application, reconcile remittances against open items before posting, and claw back any duplicate refunds.

compounds.name: Deduction-Dispute Double Play
compounds.description: Dispute splitting and Friday slicing on the deduction side, paired with duplicate-payment bait on the cash side — the same customer working both the dispute queue and the cash-app queue at once.
compounds.recommendation: Cross-link the deduction and cash-application cases, hold refunds pending dispute resolution, and flag the account for coordinated behaviour review.

compounds.name: Strategic Account Exploitation
compounds.description: A strategic account using relationship shielding, 29th-day dispute timing, and partial breadcrumb payments — leveraging its importance to stretch terms with impunity.
compounds.recommendation: Elevate to the account executive and CFO sponsor: renegotiate terms, cap shielding, and make continued strategic pricing contingent on payment behaviour.

compounds.name: Coordinated Payment Avoidance
compounds.description: A legal-entity shell game, portal sabotage, and partial breadcrumb payments moving in lock-step — a coordinated effort to make paying on time structurally impossible.
compounds.recommendation: Verify the paying legal entity, restore a working payment channel, and require a firm promise-to-pay with milestone tracking before extending further credit.
